unmatched.quote: Score 10: exactly on the threshold. One more clue and it goes to junk; one fewer and it reaches the inbox.
unmatched.problem: It says one more clue is needed to reach junk. But the sentence I just built at score 10 said 'so it goes to junk'.
unmatched.why: unexplained-jump. The two lines disagree: at 10 it is already junk, so it is one fewer clue that gives the inbox. Later screens (cmp, br.r2) confirm that 10 means junk, so I don't know which line to trust.
unmatched.fix: State that 10 reaches the line and goes to junk, and that a score of 9 or less goes to the inbox.

unmatched.quote: ఇంకో ఆధారం ఉంటే జంక్‌కి వెళ్తుంది; ఒకటి తక్కువైతే ఇన్‌బాక్స్‌కి చేరుతుంది.
unmatched.problem: It says one more clue is needed for junk, yet the sentence at score 10 already says it goes to junk.
unmatched.why: unexplained-jump. The two lines disagree, and I can't tell whether 10 is junk or inbox.
unmatched.fix: Say that 10 reaches the line and goes to junk, and that one fewer goes to the inbox.

unmatched.quote: One more clue and it goes to junk; one fewer and it reaches the inbox.
unmatched.problem: The line contradicts the sentence shown at score 10 and the later 'at least' wording in the post-check.
unmatched.why: unexplained-jump. I check boundaries first, and the boundary is stated two ways. The later feedback (post1.fb: '12 is at least 10') makes it clear that 10 is junk.
unmatched.fix: Make the boundary wording the same everywhere: at or above 10 is junk.

unmatched.quote: इनाम वाला संदेश: 3 “!”, 2 पैसे वाले शब्द, 1 जल्दबाज़ी वाला शब्द (3 + 4 + 3)
unmatched.problem: The sum (3 + 4 + 3) has a 4 that comes from 2 money words at 2 points each. That multiplication is not shown. The same is true of '(4)' in bh.i7.
unmatched.why: number-trouble. I lose confidence when a number appears without its steps. I can't see where the 4 came from, so I can't check the 10.
unmatched.fix: Show the step, e.g. 2 पैसे वाले शब्द x 2 अंक = 4. Do the same in bh.i7.

unmatched.quote: वह कभी थकी नहीं, और उसने कभी अपनी समझ का इस्तेमाल भी नहीं किया: दो धोखे, खाता बंद वाला संदेश और ₹99 वाला संदेश, इनबॉक्स में पहुँच गए।
unmatched.problem: A sentence of about 28 words carries a list inside it, after a colon.
unmatched.why: reading-load. Long sentences make me lose the thread, and this one asks me to keep two scams in mind.
unmatched.fix: Split it so the two slipped-through scams get their own short sentence.

unmatched.quote: work out its score with the points above
unmatched.problem: It points to 'the points above', but this screen is in a later stage and shows no points. The 1, 2 and 3 points are only on the earlier knob screen.
unmatched.why: confusing-instruction. I don't remember the values and can't see them. The instruction refers to something not there.
unmatched.fix: Repeat the three point values on this screen, or link to them.
